subject.title: Create example OpenClaw plugin using before_install

question: Should ClawScan own a repo-hosted OpenClaw `before_install` example plugin, or should the example remain an external OpenClaw plugin package until the product boundary is clearer?
rationale: The requested work is useful security workflow documentation, but current VISION.md and AGENTS.md keep ClawScan CLI-first and defer plugin/package surface without maintainer direction.

options.title: Keep external first
options.body: Preserve or publish the plugin as a separate OpenClaw package and revisit repo inclusion only after maintainers confirm ClawScan should own this example.

options.title: Sponsor repo-hosted example
options.body: Allow a focused PR that adds only the plugin package, local OpenClaw proof, and docs, without new public ClawScan CLI flags or README roadmap claims.

options.title: Close after external publication
options.body: If the example is published elsewhere and no ClawScan code or docs change remains, close this issue with a link to that package.

recommendation.title: Keep external first
recommendation.body: Preserve or publish the plugin as a separate OpenClaw package and revisit repo inclusion only after maintainers confirm ClawScan should own this example.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the default code owner and authored the related off-main plugin work.
